headline: Trump thanks Tarique Rahman for Boeing aircraft purchase
summary: US President Donald Trump expressed hope of meeting Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon and praised the decision to buy Boeing aircraft.
details: US President Donald Trump has expressed hope of meeting Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon, stating that Bangladesh and its people have a "very bright future" under his leadership.
In a letter to the Bangladeshi prime minister, Trump voiced optimism about the country's future and conveyed his "warmest regards and love" to the people of Bangladesh.
Trump specifically thanked Tarique Rahman for the decision to purchase Boeing aircraft, assuring that the company would not let the country down.
"I just received your letter concerning the purchase of Boeing Aircraft, and very much appreciate your decision of purchase. Boeing will not let you down, and I will not forget," Trump wrote.
The US president concluded the letter by thanking Tarique Rahman for his attention to the matter and expressed his desire to meet in the "not too distant future."
caption:
Donald Trump writes to PM Tarique Rahman, praising the Boeing aircraft purchase and expressing hope for a meeting.

US President Donald Trump has expressed hope of meeting Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon, stating that Bangladesh and its people have a "very bright future" under his leadership.

In a letter to the Bangladeshi prime minister, Trump voiced optimism about the country's future and conveyed his "warmest regards and love" to the people of Bangladesh.

Trump specifically thanked Tarique Rahman for the decision to purchase Boeing aircraft, assuring that the company would not let the country down.

"I just received your letter concerning the purchase of Boeing Aircraft, and very much appreciate your decision of purchase. Boeing will not let you down, and I will not forget," Trump wrote.

The US president concluded the letter by thanking Tarique Rahman for his attention to the matter and expressed his desire to meet in the "not too distant future."

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team]]
headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: The football legend leaves behind a legacy of World Cup, Copa America, and Finalissima titles, leaving the Albiceleste to find a new No. 10.
details: Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, marking the end of an extraordinary international career. The football icon leaves the Albiceleste after leading them to World Cup, Copa America, and Finalissima glory.
Messi first donned the iconic No. 10 jersey on March 28, 2009, in a 4-0 win over Venezuela. For over a decade, the shirt became inseparable from his identity and the hopes of a nation.

The national team now faces the challenge of who will inherit the legendary No. 10 shirt. While players like Franco Mastantuono, Angel Correa, and Paulo Dybala have worn it in his absence, none have yet been named the permanent successor.

Other potential candidates for the jersey include Lautaro Martinez, Alexis Mac Allister, and Nicolas Paz. Rodrigo De Paul, Leandro Paredes, and Giovani Lo Celso are also among those with previous experience wearing the number.
Beyond the jersey, replacing Messi's influence on the pitch is a far greater challenge. Argentina loses its greatest creator and one of its most prolific scorers who defined an entire era of success.

The team has shown it can function collectively without him, as seen in their recent 4-1 victory over Brazil. The strategy may be to spread his creative and scoring responsibilities among several players like Julian Alvarez and Enzo Fernandez.
The football world continues to pay tribute to the legendary player, with figures like David Beckham and FIFA President Gianni Infantino hailing his extraordinary career and humility.
caption:
The day football fans feared has arrived. Lionel Messi officially retires from the Argentina national team.

Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, marking the end of an extraordinary international career. The football icon leaves the Albiceleste after leading them to World Cup, Copa America, and Finalissima glory.

Messi first donned the iconic No. 10 jersey on March 28, 2009, in a 4-0 win over Venezuela. For over a decade, the shirt became inseparable from his identity and the hopes of a nation.

The national team now faces the challenge of who will inherit the legendary No. 10 shirt. While players like Franco Mastantuono, Angel Correa, and Paulo Dybala have worn it in his absence, none have yet been named the permanent successor.

Other potential candidates for the jersey include Lautaro Martinez, Alexis Mac Allister, and Nicolas Paz. Rodrigo De Paul, Leandro Paredes, and Giovani Lo Celso are also among those with previous experience wearing the number.

Beyond the jersey, replacing Messi's influence on the pitch is a far greater challenge. Argentina loses its greatest creator and one of its most prolific scorers who defined an entire era of success.

The team has shown it can function collectively without him, as seen in their recent 4-1 victory over Brazil. The strategy may be to spread his creative and scoring responsibilities among several players like Julian Alvarez and Enzo Fernandez.

The football world continues to pay tribute to the legendary player, with figures like David Beckham and FIFA President Gianni Infantino hailing his extraordinary career and humility.
